mapper.insert: insert into tj_favorite (user_id, content_id, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{contentId}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from tj_favorite where user_id = #{userId} and content_id = #{contentId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from tj_favorite where user_id = #{userId} and content_id = #{contentId}

select f.favorite_id, f.user_id, f.content_id, f.create_time, c.reign_id, c.volume_id, c.number, c.original, c.simplified, c.translation, c.tags, concat_ws('', r.emperor_name, r.reign_name, r.year_anno) as reign_title, v.title as volume_title from tj_favorite f join tj_content c on c.content_id = f.content_id left join tj_reign r on r.reign_id = c.reign_id left join tj_volume v on v.volume_id = c.volume_id where f.user_id = #{userId} order by f.favorite_id desc
